components.name: Inventory Service
components.narrative: Inventory Service continues to update its internal inventory table after stock reservation. As of this ADR, it has been modified to also publish the Stock Updated contract, enabling downstream notification services to react to stock reservation events without duplicating notification logic within the service itself.

components.name: Notification Service
components.narrative: Notification Service is a newly introduced component that isolates notification-channel complexity (email, SMS, push) in a dedicated service. It subscribes to Stock Updated events published by Inventory Service and sends customer confirmation notifications after stock has been reserved, replacing the need for notification logic to be duplicated across Inventory Service and Payment Service.

components.name: Order Service
components.narrative: Order Service continues publishing Order Events but has been modified to maintain this contract only for one release cycle during the migration period. After Payment Service completes its migration to Payment Confirmed, Order Events will be removed entirely. The service itself remains functionally unchanged except for the planned deprecation timeline.

components.name: Payment Service
components.narrative: Payment Service has been modified to migrate away from consuming Order Events toward reading buyer confirmation details from Payment Confirmed. This migration occurs during the remaining release cycle while Order Service continues publishing Order Events for backward compatibility. The service's core payment confirmation logic is being decoupled from the deprecated Order Events contract.

components.name: Legacy Order Monolith
components.narrative: Legacy Order Monolith remains untouched by this ADR and continues running functionality that has not yet migrated to the modern service architecture. It is not affected by the Stock Updated introduction, Notification Service creation, or Order Events deprecation.

contracts.name: Stock Updated
contracts.narrative: Stock Updated is a newly introduced data contract published by Inventory Service after stock has been reserved for an order. It carries order identification, SKU count, and reservation timestamp information, enabling Notification Service and other downstream consumers to react to stock reservation events. This contract replaces the need for notification logic to be embedded in Inventory Service itself.

order_fulfillment_platform.en.vtt.architecture_narrative: The architecture has been significantly modified to improve separation of concerns and reduce duplication. Inventory Service now publishes Stock Updated events, enabling a new dedicated Notification Service to handle all notification-channel complexity (email, SMS, push) in one place rather than scattered across multiple services. Concurrently, Order Events is being deprecated as Payment Service migrates to Payment Confirmed during a one-release-cycle transition period. Legacy Order Monolith remains unchanged. The net effect is improved maintainability through isolation of notification concerns and a cleaner event-driven architecture, at the cost of introducing a new Inventory Service dependency for customer notifications and accepting potential slight delays when Inventory Service is slow.

documents.order_fulfillment_platform.en.vtt:
# ADR — Stock Updated Notification Flow and Order Events Deprecation ## 1. ADR ### Context Before this change, Inventory Service updated only its internal inventory table after reserving stock for an order. Order Service publishes Order Events, and Payment Service is its last remaining consumer. Legacy Order Monolith remains unchanged and continues to run functionality that has not migrated. Notification-channel complexity is expected to grow across email, SMS, and push. The team is isolating that complexity in a dedicated Notification Service rather than duplicating it in Inventory Service or Payment Service. Order Events is being deprecated because Payment Confirmed and Stock Updated together replace it end-to-end. ### Decision - Modify **Inventory Service** to publish the new **Stock Updated** contract after reserving stock, in addition to updating its internal inventory table. - Introduce **Notification Service** as a separate component that subscribes to **Stock Updated** and sends customer confirmation notifications. - Deprecate **Order Events**. Order Service will continue publishing it for one release cycle while Payment Service migrates to reading buyer confirmation details from Payment Confirmed; Order Events will be removed once that migration is complete. - Modify **Payment Service** to migrate away from Order Events to Payment Confirmed during the remaining release cycle. - Keep **Legacy Order Monolith** unchanged. ### Consequences - Notification-channel complexity is isolated in Notification Service and is not duplicated across Inventory Service and Payment Service. - Customer notification now depends on Stock Updated arriving from Inventory Service. - Customer notifications can be slightly delayed when Inventory Service is slow. - The team accepts the additional Inventory Service dependency and potential notification delay in exchange for improved long-term maintainability. - Implementation includes updates to monitoring dashboards, on-call runbooks, and internal documentation for new or changed components and contracts. - Each migration stage is complete when its target components pass the existing test suite with no new failures. - Overall success requires zero data loss and no increase in checkout error rate compared with the pre-migration baseline. - The decision will be revisited if migration data drift or reliability issues cannot be reconciled with the current approach. ## 2. Previous Architecture ```mermaid flowchart LR OrderService[Order Service] --> OrderEvents[Order Events] OrderEvents --> PaymentService[Payment Service] InventoryService[Inventory Service] LegacyOrderMonolith[Legacy Order Monolith] ``` ## 3. Target Architecture ```mermaid flowchart LR InventoryService[Inventory Service] --> StockUpdated[Stock Updated] StockUpdated --> NotificationService[Notification Service] OrderService[Order Service] --> OrderEvents[Order Events
deprecated; transition only] OrderEvents --> PaymentService[Payment Service] PaymentConfirmed[Payment Confirmed] --> PaymentService LegacyOrderMonolith[Legacy Order Monolith] ``` ## 4. Affected Components | Component | Change | Description | |---|---|---| | Inventory Service | **MODIFIED** | Continues updating its internal inventory table after stock reservation and now publishes Stock Updated. | | Notification Service | **NEW** | Subscribes to Stock Updated and sends customer confirmation notifications after stock reservation. | | Order Service | **MODIFIED** | Continues publishing Order Events for one release cycle while Payment Service completes its migration. | | Payment Service | **MODIFIED** | Migrates from Order Events to reading buyer confirmation details from Payment Confirmed. | | Legacy Order Monolith | **UNCHANGED** | Remains untouched this month and continues running functionality that has not migrated. | ## 5. Affected Data Contracts | Data Contract | Component | Change | Version | |---|---|---|---| | Stock Updated | Inventory Service | **NEW** | 1.0.0 | | Order Events | Order Service | **DEPRECATED** | Not stated | ## 6. ODCS Data Contract Specifications ### 6.1 Stock Updated — New ```yaml apiVersion: v3.0.0 kind: DataContract name: stock-updated version: 1.0.0 status: active description: Published by Inventory Service after stock has been reserved for an order. schema: properties: order_id: type: string required: true description: Identifier linking the record back to the order. sku_count: type: integer required: true description: Number of distinct SKUs reserved. reserved_at: type: string required: true description: ISO-8601 timestamp at which the stock reservation happened. ``` ### 6.2 Order Events — Deprecated ```yaml apiVersion: v3.0.0 kind: DataContract name: Order Events version: not stated status: deprecated description: Published by Order Service and consumed by Payment Service during the remaining migration release cycle. Payment Confirmed and Stock Updated replace this contract end-to-end. schema: properties: {} **[unknown — flagged by review]** ``` ## 7. ODCS Artifacts ```text stock-updated/ └── v1.0.0.yaml Order Events/ └── vnot-stated.yaml **[unknown — flagged by review]** ```
